# Console commands

Every command the firmware's USB serial console accepts, from the command table in
`main.c`. Usage is the text the command itself prints when called incorrectly. "Runs"
says where the firmware executes it: in the sweep thread (waits for the current point),
whether it interrupts a running sweep, whether it is also allowed while the UI owns the
sweep thread, and whether command scripts (`.cmd`/`.nvs`) may use it. Commands are
case-sensitive except where two spellings are listed.

| Command | Usage | Runs | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scan` | `scan {start(Hz)} {stop(Hz)} [points] [outmask]` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep | Sweep start..stop with the given point count and print data selected by the output mask (bit 1 frequencies, 2 S11, 4 S21, 8 raw/uncalibrated). |
| `scan_bin` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep | Like `scan` but streams the results in a compact binary format (for PC software). |
| `data` | `data [array]` | main loop | Print the current sweep data: 0 = S11, 1 = S21 (real imaginary per line); 2..6 dump the calibration arrays. |
| `frequencies` | — | main loop | Print the frequency of every sweep point, one per line. |
| `freq` | `freq {frequency(Hz)}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Set continuous-wave output at one frequency (stops the sweep). |
| `sweep` | `sweep {start(Hz)} [stop(Hz)] [points]  sweep {start\|stop\|center\|span\|cw\|step\|var} {freq(Hz)}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Show or set the sweep: `sweep start [stop] [points]`, or `sweep {mode|freq|div|mul|...} value` for individual parameters. |
| `power` | `power {0-3}\|{255 - auto}` | usable in scripts | Set the Si5351 output drive level 0..3 (2, 4, 6, 8 mA), or 255 for automatic. |
| `offset` | `offset {frequency offset(Hz)}` | sweep thread, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Show or set the IF (intermediate frequency) offset in Hz. |
| `bandwidth` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set the IF bandwidth index (0 = widest/fastest; larger values narrow the filter and slow the sweep). |
| `time` | — | also from the UI | Show or set the real-time clock. |
| `sd_list` | `sd_list {pattern}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | List files on the SD card matching a pattern. |
| `sd_read` | `sd_read {filename}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Print a file from the SD card over the console. |
| `sd_delete` | `sd_delete {filename}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Delete a file from the SD card. |
| `saveconfig` | — | usable in scripts | Save the device configuration to flash. |
| `clearconfig` | `clearconfig {protection key}` | usable in scripts | Erase the saved configuration and calibration slots (needs the protection key 1234). |
| `dump` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep | Dump raw ADC samples from the codec for debugging. |
| `touchcal` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep | Run the touch-screen calibration procedure. |
| `touchtest` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep | Touch-screen test: draws where you touch until you release. |
| `pause` | — | interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Pause the sweep. |
| `resume` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Resume the sweep. |
| `msg` | `msg delay [text] [header]` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, usable in scripts | Show a message box on the screen for `delay` milliseconds. |
| `cal` | `cal [load\|open\|short\|thru\|isoln\|done\|on\|off\|reset]` | sweep thread | Calibration control: collect a standard (`load`, `open`, `short`, `thru`, `isoln`), finish with `done`, `on`/`off` to apply, `reset` to clear. |
| `save` | `save 0..6` | usable in scripts | Save the current calibration and settings to slot N. |
| `recall` | `recall 0..6` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Recall calibration and settings from slot N. |
| `trace` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set a trace: `trace N {format} [channel]`, `trace N off`, or scale/refpos. |
| `marker` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set markers: `marker N on|off`, `marker N {index}`. |
| `edelay` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set the electrical delay applied to S11 or S21, in seconds. |
| `s21offset` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set the S21 level offset in dB (for an external attenuator). |
| `capture` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Dump the screen over the console (RLE8-compressed RGB565 framebuffer) for a PC-side screenshot. |
| `measure` | `measure {none\|lc\|lcshunt\|lcseries\|xtal\|filter\|cable\|resonance}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Select a MEASURE panel by name (see the list in the usage text). |
| `refresh` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Force a full screen redraw. |
| `touch` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Inject a touch-down at x y (for automation and testing). |
| `release` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI | Inject a touch release (for automation and testing). |
| `vbat` | — | usable in scripts | Print the battery voltage in millivolts. |
| `tcxo` | `tcxo {TCXO frequency(Hz)}` | usable in scripts | Show or set the reference oscillator frequency (Hz) used by the clock generator. |
| `reset` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, usable in scripts | Reboot the device (`reset dfu` reboots into the USB DFU bootloader). |
| `smooth` | `smooth {0-8}` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Show or set the trace smoothing factor 0..8. |
| `config` | `config {auto\|avg\|connection\|mode\|grid\|dot\|bk\|flip\|separator\|tif} [0\|1]` | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Show or set a device mode flag (see the list in the usage text). |
| `usart_cfg` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Configure the UART: speed and mode. |
| `usart` | — | sweep thread, interrupts the sweep, also from the UI, usable in scripts | Show or set the serial (UART) speed. |
| `vbat_offset` | — | usable in scripts | Show or set the battery-voltage measurement offset in millivolts. |
| `transform` | `transform {on\|off\|impulse\|step\|bandpass\|minimum\|normal\|maximum} [...]` | usable in scripts | Time-domain transform control: on/off, impulse/step/bandpass, window minimum/normal/maximum. |
| `threshold` | `threshold {frequency in harmonic mode}` | usable in scripts | Show or set the frequency above which harmonic mode is used. |
| `help` | — | main loop | List the available commands. |
| `info` | — | main loop | Print board, MCU and build information (the About screen's text). |
| `version` | — | main loop | Print the firmware version string. |
| `*IDN?` | — | main loop | SCPI-style identification: `NanoVNA,<board>,<serial>,<version>` (also accepted lower-case). |
| `*idn?` | — | main loop | Lower-case alias of `*IDN?`. |
| `color` | `color {id} {rgb24}` | usable in scripts | Set palette entry `id` to a 24-bit RGB colour. |
